title: scan executor
description: Run SkillSpector security scan on a skill directory.

path.description: Path to the skill directory to scan (relative to workspace root).

annotations.description: Emit GitHub workflow annotations for code findings. Default: true.

failOnError.description: Fail the target when HIGH or CRITICAL findings are present. Default: true.

skillspectorBin.description: Binary to invoke for skillspector. Default: "skillspector".

sarif.description: SARIF output file path. When set, a SARIF 2.1.0 report is written.

baseline.description: Baseline file path for suppressing known findings.
